  • Method Details

    • register

      public ChromaticDefinitions.Registration register(ChromaticDefinitions.Kind kind, net.minecraft.util.ResourceLocation id, Object trigger, Integer color, IChromaticEffect effect)
      Adds or replaces a draft declaration without publishing it yet.

      Character triggers normalize to lowercase. Named triggers retain their exact spelling, even when lookups ignore case. Replacing the same kind/trigger updates its slot in place; another kind can keep its own entry for that trigger. Triggerless effects use their identity as the slot instead.

      The receipt refers to this draft object. It becomes live only if that object remains in the published batch; a later register or remove in the same callback can discard it. To cancel this draft entry, call remove(receipt.binding()). Closing the receipt checks published state and does not remove an unpublished draft entry.

      Parameters:
      kind - category of declaration
      id - non-null namespaced identity
      trigger - kind-appropriate character/name; ignored for a triggerless effect
      color - RGB integer exactly when the kind is a color kind; masked to 24 bits
      effect - shared callback exactly when the kind is an effect kind
      Returns:
      receipt for this draft binding, which may become live on publication
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the editor has closed
      IllegalArgumentException - if the trigger/value combination is invalid
      NullPointerException - if kind or id is null
